summary: This clinical trial compares two different medication approaches in patients with minimal to intermediate coronary artery disease, which is a narrowing of the heart's blood vessels. Researchers want to compare a combination of low-dose rosuvastatin and ezetimibe against a high-dose rosuvastatin monotherapy. The study is currently Recruiting with a target enrollment of 6356 participants. Saint Vincent's Hospital, Korea is sponsoring this Phase 4 trial.
